rows.note: This is the usual choice when “bureaucracy” means burdensome red tape and excessive procedures.

example.english: This application involves so much bureaucracy that I still haven't sorted it out after several weeks.
example.traditional: 呢份申請表有太多繁文縟節，搞到我幾個星期都未搞掂。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 san1 cing2 biu2 jau5 taai3 do1 faan4 man4 juk6 zit3 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 gei2 go3 sing1 kei4 dou1 mei6 gaau2 dim6

rows.note: Use this for the all-purpose idea of a bureaucracy as an administrative system organized into official departments and ranks.

example.traditional: 呢套官僚制度運作得好慢。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 gun1 liu4 zai6 dou6 wan6 zok3 dak1 hou2 maan6

rows.note: Use this when referring to the bureaucracy as the body or organizational machinery of officials.

example.english: The government's bureaucracy has never been very efficient.
example.traditional: 政府嘅官僚機構一向效率唔高。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 ge3 gun1 liu4 gei1 kau3 jat1 hoeng3 haau6 leot6 m4 gou1

rows.note: Use this specifically for government conducted by officials and bureaucratic administrators rather than elected representatives.

example.english: This place is governed by bureaucracy, not elected representatives.
example.traditional: 呢個地方由官僚政治主導，唔係由民選代表決定。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 jau4 gun1 liu4 zing3 zi6 zyu2 dou6 m4 hai6 jau4 man4 syun2 doi6 biu2 kyut3 ding6
